name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_osteitis_deformans_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of osteitis deformans (osseous Paget's disease).
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of osteitis deformans (osseous Paget's disease).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of osteitis deformans (osseous Paget's disease).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of osteitis deformans (osseous Paget's disease).
